branching: ask ideation levels 1-5 in order; intensity only if any ideation endorsed; behavior categories asked separately; potential lethality only when actual lethality is 0
completeness_rule: unanswered/partial/complete/not_assessed per v1 contract; per-level time-window/current-vs-lifetime fields documented for each positive; explicit negatives required for a reviewed no-ideation result

behavior.question_focus: Did the person begin steps toward an attempt but stop themselves before the self-injurious act occurred?
Did the person engage in potentially self-injurious behavior with at least some intent to die? Injury is not required.
Did another person or an outside circumstance stop the person after the attempt had begun but before the self-injurious act occurred?
Did the person intentionally injure themselves without suicidal intent? Document separately from suicidal behavior.
Did the person take steps toward an attempt, such as obtaining or arranging a method, writing a suicide note, or giving away possessions?

definition_proposal.behavior_fields: present/absent + dates + counts + intent + most recent event per category

ideation_levels.paraphrased_question: Have you wished you were dead, or wished you could go to sleep and not wake up?
Have you had thoughts of killing yourself, without thinking about a method, intent, or plan?
Have you thought about how you might kill yourself, without intending to act on those thoughts?
Have you had suicidal thoughts and some intention of acting on them, but without a specific plan?
Have you worked out a method or plan for killing yourself, and do you intend to carry it out?

intensity_dimensions.controllability: 1 = easily; 2 = with little difficulty; 3 = with some difficulty; 4 = with much difficulty; 5 = unable; 0 = does not try
intensity_dimensions.deterrents: 1 = definitely stopped; 2 = probably stopped; 3 = uncertain; 4 = probably did not stop; 5 = definitely did not stop; 0 = not applicable
intensity_dimensions.duration: 1 = seconds/minutes; 2 = less than an hour; 3 = 1-4 hours; 4 = 4-8 hours/most of the day; 5 = more than 8 hours or persistent
intensity_dimensions.frequency: 1 = less than weekly; 2 = once weekly; 3 = 2-5 days/week; 4 = daily/almost daily; 5 = many times daily
intensity_dimensions.reasons: 1 = entirely attention/reaction; 2 = mostly attention/reaction; 3 = both equally; 4 = mostly to end pain; 5 = entirely to end pain; 0 = not applicable

definition_proposal.lethality: actual medical lethality/damage 0-5 + potential lethality 0-2 when actual is 0, as recorded fields
definition_proposal.per_level_fields: time window + current-vs-lifetime designation + own description + clinician determination per positive response

independent_examples.expected: severity 3; levels 1-2 NOT auto-filled in stored answers (shape proposed, values literal)
independent_examples.inputs: level 3 endorsed with time window; levels 1-2 left unanswered in storage
independent_examples.name: level-3-endorsed case

independent_examples.expected: reviewed no-ideation result severity 0 (shape proposed, values literal)
independent_examples.inputs: all levels 1-5 explicitly negative in assessed window
independent_examples.name: all-explicit-negative case

result_rule.intensity_behavior_lethality: recorded separately, never summed into a composite
result_rule.no_autofill: no auto-fill of lower levels from a higher endorsement in stored answers
result_rule.severity: highest endorsed level 0-5 (ordinal, not a probability)
result_rule.triage_flags: source demonstration table recorded as proposed-not-approved pending local-policy review
result_rule.v1: v1 generic evaluator covers only the max-severity part; branching/alerts need S11 typed implementation

uncertainties: owner must select exact form + time windows (recent past-month ideation 4/5? past-3-month behavior? 'typically' needs confirmation)
authorized wording source for exact administration wording/probes
local alert protocol mapping for triage flags
wording_status: paraphrase — NOT the authorized form; exact administration wording/probes must come from the authorized instrument
